title: The normalized roots comparison is invertible for arbitrary base change
statement: Let n be a nonzero natural number and g:X -> Y a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with n a unit in Gamma(Y,O_Y). On the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], use the roots sheaves [def-asd-etale-roots-of-unity] and inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. The canonical kernel map g^{-1}mu[n,Y] -> mu[n,X], obtained from the pullback of units and the kernel inclusion, is an isomorphism. Its composite with the target kernel inclusion is g^{-1}(the source kernel inclusion) followed by pullback of units.

proof.text: Use the already proved source theorem isIso_upperStarRootsOfUnitySheafToRootsOfUnitySheaf_of_isUnit, in WeilConjectures/EtaleCohomology/TateTwist/RootsOfUnityPullback.lean, lines 166-209. Its construction adjoins a primitive n-root by primitiveRootsCover, identifies both roots sheaves with the constant cyclic sheaf on that etale surjection, and descends invertibility. The normalization is the kernel lift equation upperStarRootsOfUnitySheafToRootsOfUnitySheaf_ι in TateTwist/Sheaf.lean. No affine representability lemma from the old plan is needed.
